07 / ABOUT ME
Lead with curiosity.
Make every story count.

A journalism graduate and goal-getter for Jesus.

My journey from student journalist to creative strategist has been shaped by faith, hard work, and a passion for turning ideas into meaningful stories. I started with little knowledge but a willingness to learn, and I continue to grow and refine my craft with every experience.

I believe in creating with purpose, working with intention, and honoring God in everything I do.

Based in the Philippines, open to working with clients worldwide.
